About UWGP
United Wisconsin Grain Producers is a farmer-owned ethanol production facility located in Friesland, Wisconsin. We process locally grown corn into renewable ethanol fuel, distillers grains (DDGs), corn oil, and high-protein yeast products for livestock feed and global markets.
With a focus on efficiency, consistency, and strong producer relationships, UWGP plays a key role in supporting Wisconsin agriculture while contributing to sustainable energy solutions.
What We Do
UWGP connects local corn producers to global energy and feed markets through efficient ethanol production and co-product processing.
Corn purchasing and grain receiving
Ethanol production and distribution
Distillers grains (DDGs) for livestock feed
